clips.caption:
He sat in the marketing meetings where this was decided, so he can tell you exactly how it works.

The question in the room was never "how do we make this healthy." It was "how do we convince the consumer it's healthy" - on a product already loaded with chemicals, hydrogenated oil, ingredients that cause real harm. The answer: pay lobbyists to help define "all natural" so loosely that almost anything qualifies, up to fifteen thousand different chemicals.

The word was never describing the product. It was describing you - what you'd believe if they just picked the right word.
